title: Naggaarinni qaddooseh yan gira
intro: Sadi aydaadih addat, uddur ellecabo fan migaq kaak maabitina yekkeh yan muuci soolah yan. Tama num ramaddiinuuk naqboytiino dooriteeh, rammitleemih saduh, racmatta seecoh saduh soole. cubbil ankacis dumaahi maybalaalaqah xongoloola nanu ta qaxmeqe roocih mamaxxaga reebisna wak.
clues: Anu Yallih farmoytih innah inki kedoodat oobokeeh, uxih kulli uddur keenil sooleh an.
Yi migaq maqna quukah- migaq maqna ' girah abba,' migaq too silaal yok amotani maadi.
Anu numma quuka numul biyak cabeh, walaa yi buxah mari ta qangiinoh gaatut yengele.
Anu inni gaddat kee diihayat xoqoysimeh Yallih seeco tibba hayuh, lakqo qibaadah ifi bargussam xiqtaamal aamineh.
Yalli inkih tan mafdaga yoh yeceeh—mafdaga kaxxam uxxuk tan, sekenxitteh addat qimbbimtam duddah, takkay immay qilsa kak qimmoh ayro fanah raqte.
